dialog.help.title: Search Syntax Help
dialog.help.text:
Search Syntax Help

· Multiple keywords separated by spaces are combined with AND
· | separates alternatives (OR)
· ! prefix means NOT (exclude), e.g. !test

"..."   exact phrase match, e.g. "config file"
* and ?  wildcards, * matches any chars, ? matches one char

name: / n:   search by file name only (excluding path)
path: / p:   search within the full path
size: / s:   filter by size, supports = < > <= >= and range 10kb..1mb
dm: / datemodified:   filter by modified time, e.g. dm:2024-01-01
case:   case-sensitive match
regex:  use regular expression, e.g. regex:.*\.log$

Examples:
  config         search files containing config
  name:test      file name contains test
  size:>1mb      size larger than 1MB
  *.log | *.txt  extension is log or txt
  !temp          exclude files containing temp
